column1: # WikiText-2: flow map with one duration per position (adaptive speed), distilled from the time-free denoiser trained with random
# clean positions, against plain EqFM distilled from the same denoiser with the same steps. 4 seeds. Sampled at 8 steps.
#  plain   : semigroup target, one duration for the whole sequence (the recipe of W2S_eqfm_distill).
#  speed   : loss.position_speed=8 -> states with one progress per position, jump = one adaptive step 1 + beta g, beta ~ U[0, 8].
#  speedlag: the same with the Lagrangian target for one duration per position.
